title: noah-ramirez-private-deploy-scratchpad-2026-03-04
content:
Context / quick summary:
- Onsite kickoff call with NYC-FinCo today. Objective: first private deployment (small cluster) in customer VPC for pilot. They want air-gapped-like controls but will use a private subnet in their AWS account + transit gateway to our support VPC for agent updates.
- This doc = my working scratchpad for steps, open questions, and blockers. Not final runbook.

High-level plan (pilot):
1) Prepare infra: IAM roles, VPC/subnet mapping, SGs, route tables.
2) Build and push signed images to their ECR (or allow pull from our registry via VPC endpoint).
3) KMS/HSM key decision + set up envelope encryption for model data + config.
4) Deploy control-plane agent (lightweight) into customer account, validate connectivity back to private control plane.
5) Deploy small Dedicated pool (2 x g5.2x) inside private deployment; run smoke tests.
6) Hand over monitoring + daily runbook items to CS.

Quick todo (today):
- [ ] Confirm final CIDR ranges for peer (NYC-FinCo) and add to infra TODOs
- [ ] Ask infra ops to pre-create VPC endpoints for ECR + S3 in customer account (necessary for airgap-like flow)
- [ ] Get customer KMS decision: AWS KMS (preferred) vs. on-prem HSM. -> Email sent to security contact (Aaron).
- [ ] Share minimal list of required ports/egress rules with customer (see network notes below)
- [ ] Create PD ticket to get signed images ready (link PR to above GH PR)

Detailed install notes (commands & snippets):
- Image provisioning:
  - If pulling from our registry: ensure peering + private-link to our ECR. Fallback: push prod-signed images to customer's ECR (we provide role).
  - Example docker tag: redwood-inference/serve:v1.8.2-signed -> customer's-ecr.amazonaws.com/redwood/serve:v1.8.2-signed

- KMS/HSM:
  - Prefer AWS KMS CMKs in their account + key policy that allows our service principal to use encrypt/decrypt for model blobs.
  - If HSM requested: need timeline for procurement + cert exchange. This will block pilot (likely >2w).

- Networking (NYC-FinCo specifics):
  - Customer asked to restrict outbound to only our support IPs; we need to provide list. Temporary: ask for 3-day window of open egress for initial bootstrap.
  - Required outbound endpoints (TCP): 443 to our control-plane endpoints (api.redwood-inference.com), 443 to S3 endpoints in their region, 443 to ECR endpoint.
  - Internal ports for nodes: 2181 (ZK) - not used in our minimal; 9090 (metrics), 50051 (gRPC) between nodes. Recommend customer leave internal SG between cluster nodes open for these ports.
  - CIDR check: their infra sent 10.10.0.0/16 for worker subnets. Confirm no overlap with our support VPC (ask infra).

Blockers / risk items:
- Customer HSM ask — will delay. Confirm preference by EOD 2026-03-05.
- Networking: customer security wants egress-only via proxy. Need to validate our agent supports proxy environment variables and certificate pinning. TODO: test agent behind squid proxy.
- Image signing / attestation: legal wants signed images + SBOM. Need to confirm SBOM generation step in CI (I opened PR #987).
- Cert management: who will manage TLS certs for internal inter-node comms? Option A: Redwood generates and rotates (we need KMS access). Option B: Customer provides CA and we integrate.

Test checklist (smoke):
- [ ] Agent successfully registers with control plane (show heartbeat within 60s)
- [ ] Model artifacts downloaded and checksum verified
- [ ] Simple inference call returns <250ms p50 for single token (pilot target)
- [ ] Metrics push visible in Console (token counts, latency)
- [ ] Rollback plan validated: remove node -> traffic rebalances gracefully

Notes / conversation fragments (raw):
- "They prefer HSM but will consider KMS if we can show key access audit logs" - Aaron (security)
- "Can we cut an exception to allow egress to our updater for 48 hours?" - Customer infra lead (Monica)
- "Need to ensure we don't leak any model checkpoints to public S3; use customer-owned buckets only." - Legal/Compliance

Open questions (to resolve with SE/sales/customer):
- Do we push images into their ECR or allow our registry via VPC endpoints? (pros/cons: audit vs speed)
- Who owns cert rotation? Who signs node certs? (customer or Redwood?)
- Backup/restore: do they want daily model snapshot to on-prem NAS or to customer S3?
- Monitoring retention: default is 30d. Customer asked for 13 months — note for billing + infra cost.

Follow-ups (who -> what):
- Riley -> test agent behind proxy + document env vars (due 2026-03-06)
- Evelyn -> validate SBOM & CI PR #987, add legal tag (due 2026-03-05)
- Me (Noah) -> finalize network egress IP list + share with customer (today)

Final quick checklist before pilot start:
- [ ] KMS decision in writing
- [ ] ECR / image flow decided and validated
- [ ] Short bootstrap window for egress or proxy config tested
- [ ] Signed images + SBOM present in chosen registry
- [ ] First smoke test passed in staging (our env)

Scratchy notes to self:
- Keep this doc live during the week. Move cleaned steps to Confluence runbook after pilot
- If HSM is a hard requirement -> escalate to GtM (sales) for procurement timeline
- Remember to ask for a sandbox account and not to perform anything on prod CIDRs.

End of scratchpad.
